name: editora
description: Connects Claude Code to the running Editora over MCP (editora mcp), and teaches it to review code there: findings on lines, fixing and resolving review threads, and editing open buffers without losing unsaved work.

editora_bin.title: Editora command
editora_bin.description: The command that starts Editora's launcher, or its full path (editora-cli on Windows). Settings > MCP Server > Copy Connect Command shows the one for your install.
